As she arrived in the door in eye-catching silver, Rosalía beamed while hugging and kissing the label’s creative director Veronica Leoni and Javier Zotes Ciancas, Global SVP at Calvin Klein Fragrances. “It’s unmistakably Euphoria, but reinterpreted for today,” Zotes Ciancas said.

headline: Bergdorf Goodman Toasted to 125 Years with a Suitably Glamorous Get-Together
summary: For anyone who’s dreamed of being locked inside Bergdorf Goodman long after closing time, their fantasy became a reality during New York Fashion Week. “There’s so many special pieces about this place,” said Bergdorf Goodman president Tracy Margolies. You want to dream, you want to feel like family, and you want relationships.

headline: How Bardia Zeinali and Vittoria Ceretti Brought the Themes of Vogue World: Milano to Surreal Life
summary: “Regardless of where we go or how technology progresses, I still very much feel that it can’t replace certain things that are innately human,” says Bardia Zeinali , who directed the videos. “While technology can generate ideas and imitate styles, people bring their own experiences and emotion to art and that will forever be irreplaceable,” Ceretti says. “I think it becomes this kind of collage of things, and it’s kind of beautiful,” Zeinali says.
